The developer was named after Norm - not the other way around. Still awkward, but worth it...

Norm (and Nora) have worked as transit mages for many years. Transit Mages are responsible for various logistical duties in the dimension, including the postal service, general deliveries, public transportation, and sprite conduit casting and maintenance.

In its idle form, Norm's species is a small mass of gelatinous, teal material with purple flecks that drift around in it. Some substrates can control the movements of their flecks, and the flecks take about two weeks to regenerate themselves if lost through illness or trauma.
